culprit_citations.quoted_text: Portfolio Company | Type of Investment | Footnotes | Interest Rate | Acquisition Date | Par Amount / Units | Cost | Fair Value | Percentage of Net Assets

rationale: Class 1 repeated single-cell defect. The raw March 31, 2026 schedule exposes Portfolio Company, Type of Investment, and Acquisition Date as separate columns, while all 13 flagged issuer_name values concatenate the portfolio-company name with investment-type and acquisition-date text (for example, ACC Ultimate Holdings, L.P., Equity, Acquisition Date 5/8/2024). The source structure therefore confirms a wrapper/column-boundary extraction gap rather than a legitimate issuer name. No aggregate valuation anchor is relevant to C206.
